interface.signature: numBusesToDestination(routes: List[List[int]], S: int, T: int) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of bus routes is between 1 and 500, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(routes[i]) <= 10^5 for all i in range(len(routes))
preconditions.description: Each bus route contains between 1 and 10^5 bus stops, inclusive.
Each bus stop number is between 0 and 10^6, exclusive.
The starting bus stop S is different from the destination bus stop T.

postconditions.description: The function returns -1 if it is not possible to reach the destination bus stop T from the starting bus stop S, or the least number of buses required to reach the destination if possible.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not any(T in route for route in routes) else min(return_value for return_value in [numBusesToDestination(routes[:i] + routes[i+1:] + [routes[i][::-1]], S, T) for i in range(len(routes))] if return_value != -1)
postconditions.description: The function returns the least number of buses required to reach the destination bus stop T from the starting bus stop S, considering all possible bus routes that include the destination bus stop T.
